_meta.note: App UI strings (not Satisfactory catalog). Sense-based translation.

dashboard.lead1: Factory Manager is a local planner for your Satisfactory factories: item catalog, production chains, and power plans. Everything stays on your PC — no account, no cloud.
dashboard.lead2: Set output targets, work out machine counts (including overclock and power shards), set up miners on nodes, and size generators with the right fuel. Resource and power balances update as you go, and the app flags when you are short on materials or power.
dashboard.lead3: This dashboard is a quick overview: recent projects, alerts, transport plans, production targets, and your generator mix — so you can see what needs attention before you open Production, Power, or Transport.
dashboard.panelTransportSub: Vehicles needed and cargo from recent plans
dashboard.emptyNoPowerBalance: No power output or use configured yet.
dashboard.featureResourcesBody: In-game item catalog by type: ores, ingots, fluids, and components.
dashboard.featureProductionBody: Save and reopen factory projects without relying on the cloud.
dashboard.featureEnergyBody: Design extraction and generators to feed your factory.
dashboard.featureTransportBody: Size freight cars and vehicles from rate, outbound and return times.
dashboard.emptyProjectsHint: Create a production chain, power plan, or transport plan to get started.
dashboard.emptyTransportHint: Create a plan in Transport to see your fleet here.
